in_tamil.name: Niyaj
in_tamil.meaning: இந்து பெயர் என்று பொருள் Lord's command
in_tamil.long_meaning: Niyaj ஒரு இந்து பெயர் ஆகும், இது இந்திய கலாச்சாரத்தில் ஆழமான ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவத்தைக் கொண்டுள்ளது। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Ni' (Lord) and 'Yaj' (Command). This name signifies following the Lord's command.

in_telugu.name: Niyaj
in_telugu.long_meaning: Niyaj ఒక హిందూ పేరు, ఇది భారతీయ సంస్కృతిలో లోతైన ఆధ్యాత్మిక ప్రాముఖ్యతను కలిగి ఉంది। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Ni' (Lord) and 'Yaj' (Command). This name signifies following the Lord's command.

in_marathi.name: Niyaj
in_marathi.long_meaning: Niyaj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Ni' (Lord) and 'Yaj' (Command). This name signifies following the Lord's command.

in_bengali.name: Niyaj
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Lord's command
in_bengali.long_meaning: Niyaj একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Ni' (Lord) and 'Yaj' (Command). This name signifies following the Lord's command.
